title: fleet's census frame misses ~/Devel/cfg -- Gtools-geodica has run devbin 0.1.1 unseen by every sweep since 0.1.2
body:
## What happens

`fleet_roots` in `bin/.devbin/cmd/fleet` defaults to `$HOME/Devel/prj` alone; `DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS` overrides it. Its comment justifies the single root by a search made on 2026-08-29: every `bin/.devbin/manifest.sha256` under `$HOME` sat under `~/Devel/prj`, apart from agent scratch trees. That premise expired when `~/Devel/cfg` appeared on 2026-09-15, and nothing re-measured it, because the comment asks for a re-run only when someone changes the list -- and the list never changed; the disk did.

`~/Devel/cfg/Gtools-geodica` is an estate by every test the census applies: its own repository (`geodica/gtools-geodica`, remotes `local` and `upstream`), a `.git` directory rather than a worktree, live (HEAD `b6fa762`, committed 2026-09-22), and devbin 0.1.1 vendored from the machine install at `3bfa922`. `fleet audit`, `fleet upgrade` and `intent/docs/devbin-users.md` have never listed it, so every sweep from 0.1.2 to 0.1.7 reported the fleet complete without it.

## How it was found and measured

Found by laksa-dc's census on 2026-09-23, whose frame included `~/Devel/cfg` one level deep. Verified by vc the same morning with the predicate the comment itself names, run over all of `$HOME`, pruning `Library`, `.Trash`, `node_modules`, `.git`, `_build`, `deps`, `target` and `.elixir_ls`: 52 manifests, 0 find errors. Of those:

- 19 under `~/Devel/prj`: the 16 estates, `_Archive/Intentv2` and two Intent worktrees;
- 28 agent fixtures under `~/.claude/jobs/`;
- the machine install at `~/Devel/opt/devbin`;
- three worktrees under `~/Devel/scratch/`;
- and Gtools-geodica, the only estate outside the frame.

`DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS="$HOME/Devel/prj $HOME/Devel/cfg" bin/devbin fleet upgrade`, a dry run, plans it as the one estate to upgrade, with the other 16 level; nothing was written.

## What should happen

The frame is part of the census's answer, and the census cannot check it from inside, so it has to be declared where it can be seen or measured where it can go stale. Options, unranked:

- (a) Add `~/Devel/cfg` to the default. That is a second machine-specific path of exactly the kind the comment warns against.
- (b) Declare the roots in devbin's own config, since `fleet` is devbin's own command, so the frame is a visible fact rather than a default written into code.
- (c) Have the census say how many installs exist outside its frame, so a frame that has gone stale reports itself.

Whichever is chosen, the comment's premise should become something the census re-measures rather than a sentence it carries.

Upgrading Gtools-geodica itself is a separate, live-estate question and is hv's go.

## Resolution

Fixed at 1a3bbc8. Ships in 0.1.8.

- WHAT CHANGED. The census frame is a tracked file, bin/.devbin/fleet.roots (~/Devel/prj and ~/Devel/cfg), beside devbin's config rather than a key in it: fleet is devbin's own project command, and lib/config refuses an unknown key, so a key would enter the schema every estate vendors. DEVBIN_FLEET_ROOTS overrides it for one run, and a missing file, one naming no root and a variable naming none are each refused. Every run re-measures the frame's premise: it walks DEVBIN_FLEET_HOME (default $HOME) for installs no root covers. audit, doc and upgrade name each, and say beside the count what the walk does not reach: ~/Library with its CloudStorage, ~/.Trash, and anything through a symlink. A walk that could not read everything fails audit, refuses the doc, and is a NOT KNOWN row in upgrade's not-swept table.
- ON REVIEW. cc's two should-fixes -- the empty variable, and Library pruned by name, which hid ~/Dropbox's target -- and one arm gap, upgrade's NOT KNOWN row, are in.
- RED FIRST AND MUTANTS. 12 arms: the first 9 red at the series head; of the 3 added on review, two red on the handler cc reviewed, and the third holds behaviour that had no arm. 22 mutants, each parsing and each killed by the arm aimed at it, and cc's own Q1-Q3 and R1-R3 are killed too.
- THE SUITE. The full suite on v1's tree, the series plus 0116 v1: 1..1662, 1662 ok, 0 not ok, 4 skips, rc 0. v2 changes only the fleet files: fleet, documentation, help, doctor and localinstall on v2, 1..264, 264 ok.
- LEFT FOR hv. intent/docs/devbin-users.md is not regenerated, since fleet doc is hv's go. Walking ~/Library/CloudStorage is possible and is put to hv, with the walk's cost: cc measured audit at 17 s before and 52 s after.
